title: Light Is Dawning 'Mong the Hills
description: Light Is Dawning 'Mong the Hills in Tonic Solfa to HEINLEIN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the East (Paisley, in print by 1911).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sevens (7.7.7.7), and this page sets them to HEINLEIN; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Light is daw-ning 'mong the hills, Light of light Thy beams dis-play, All the dark-ness chase a-way, Light that dawned up-on our ills.

lines: Light of light Thy beams display,
Light that dawned upon our ills.
Dark the day the Cross was raised
By the hands of cruel men;
Great Thy load of sorrow then;
Dark the world while in the tomb,
Lone in death the Saviour lay,
Till the stone was rolled away,
And His Rising quelled the gloom.
Fadeless now, O Light of light,

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the East (by 1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the East; set to HEINLEIN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
